flaw_origin: first-write of kernel/av/calc_template.go: evalRollupTemplate wired text/template to sprig.TxtFuncMap() without deleting env/expandenv/getHostByName, which filesys.BuiltInTemplateFuncs already stripped for CVE-2024-55660.
